data.name: Paradisus La Perla - Adults Only - Riviera Maya
data.address: Calle 88 Nte, Luis Donaldo Colosio, 77728 Playa del Carmen, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
On lush grounds along a beach, this upscale all-inclusive resort for adults only is 3 km from the 3D Museum of Wonders and 50 km from Cancun International Airport.
Featuring balconies or terraces, the chic rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minibars. Suites add whirlpool tubs, iPod docks, sitting areas and/or swim-up access. Upgraded suites have kitchens and/or living rooms. Room service is available 24/7.
Meals and drinks (included) are served in 24 dining options and bars, including polished Mediterranean and Asian restaurants. There's also a spa and a gym, plus outdoor pools. Dance lessons, wine tastings and water sports are available.
